title: The Environmental Fellows Program
institution: Harvard University Center for the Environment

compensation.value: $92,000 per year, plus health insurance eligibility and a travel allowance

about: Two-year postdoctoral fellowship at Harvard for recent PhD or terminal-degree holders, hosted by Harvard faculty mentors. Applications for the 2027 cohort are due 1 December 2026; recommendation and host letters by 11 December 2026. Fellows and alternates are selected by late January 2027.
requirements: Terminal degree (PhD or equivalent) obtained between May 2023 and August 2027
Applicants must secure a commitment from one or more Harvard faculty members to serve as mentor and provide office or lab space for the two-year fellowship
Recommendation letters and host letters due by December 11, 2026, 5:00pm EST

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: field "Environmental research (interdisciplinary)" → objective "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."

description "Two-year postdoctoral fellowship at Harvard for recent PhD or terminal-degree holders" → objective "Compare sources, viewpoints, approaches, products, or alternatives using explicit criteria and structured analytical frameworks."
